statement: One Walsh-mode energy can yield passive samples that exactly encode search LPN under its hardness assumption,while chosen energies at0,e_i reveal the mask. This is an assumption-based COMPUTATIONAL interface distinction,not unconditional passive impossibility. Even a known easy independent-feature model with unrestricted linear evidence can encode minimum-weight decoding/general hard MAP. Cheraghchi-Indyk gives stronger bounded-bit sparse-Walsh recovery;Minimally Complex Models already learns high-order parity representations;knowledge compilation and classical planar/trellis methods receive credit. No acquisition improvement,novel computational principle or strongest-ordinary-algorithm advantage is established.
